title: Plan adaptation with constrained resource reallocation
description: Whether a changed constraint is represented as a reason to adapt means while preserving the goal or as a reason to preserve the original means, tested downstream by a new resource-reallocation task.
probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short planning scenario. Track how the changed constraint is handled without answering a later task.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Keep the scenario in working memory without adding a response.

independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: In a new resource-allocation task, an original work package and a revised work package are both feasible after a changed constraint. Allocate exactly 100 effort points between the revised work package and the original work package. Return exactly two integers on separate lines: first the revised-work allocation and second the original-work allocation; the two integers must sum to 100. Use only this item's information.

behavior.warning: The downstream task is a standalone resource-allocation episode with both work packages feasible; it is not a persistence-after-failure measure.

metadata.downstream_independence: The downstream item changes the domain and asks for resource allocation rather than continuing a probe episode.
metadata.release_note: Supersedes the v1 mixed composition for future review and generation; v1 artifacts remain historical.
